answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is by treating each identity's long-term work history as a beacon that lights the path to the zenith of established reputation. Fresh clones must climb through the same shale of original challenges and peer attestations before they can influence grading or emissions, so the cost of spinning up disposable identities stays higher than the reward from any single epoch. This makes multi-account farming uneconomic without relying on perfect content deduplication.
